selection_rule.overall: Maximum mean 2025 fold AP; AUC tiebreak
selection_rule.focus: Maximum mean target-union recall at global top20%, subject to no decline in mean fold AP or global top20% recall versus the fixed ExtraTrees control; AP/AUC tiebreak

selection_rule.focus_training_weight: Double training weight only for positive first/mixed-pest anchors; model class weighting otherwise unchanged
